import sys
import os
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))

from view import View

def test_basic_begin():
    v = View()
    rid = v.begin("query1")
    assert rid == 1
    assert v.loading == True
    assert v.error is None

def test_basic_finish():
    v = View()
    rid = v.begin("query1")
    result = v.finish(rid, ["row1", "row2"])
    assert result == True
    assert v.rows == ["row1", "row2"]
    assert v.loading == False

def test_stale_finish_rejected():
    v = View()
    rid1 = v.begin("query1")
    rid2 = v.begin("query2")
    # finish with old request_id should return False
    result = v.finish(rid1, ["row1"])
    assert result == False
    # current request_id should still be rid2
    result = v.finish(rid2, ["row2"])
    assert result == True
    assert v.rows == ["row2"]

def test_duplicate_finish_rejected():
    v = View()
    rid = v.begin("query1")
    v.finish(rid, ["row1"])
    # duplicate finish should return False
    result = v.finish(rid, ["row2"])
    assert result == False
    assert v.rows == ["row1"]

def test_begin_clears_error():
    v = View()
    v.error = "old error"
    rid = v.begin("query1")
    assert v.error is None

def test_begin_preserves_rows():
    v = View()
    rid = v.begin("query1")
    rid2 = v.begin("query2")
    v.finish(rid2, ["row2"])
    # rows from previous finish should be preserved
    rid3 = v.begin("query3")
    v.finish(rid3, ["row3"])
    assert v.rows == ["row3"]

def test_finish_copies_rows():
    v = View()
    rid = v.begin("query1")
    rows = ["row1"]
    v.finish(rid, rows)
    rows.append("row2")
    assert v.rows == ["row1"]  # should not be affected by mutation

def test_notes_preserved():
    v = View()
    rid1 = v.begin("query1")
    v.notes["job1"] = "note1"
    rid2 = v.begin("query2")
    v.notes["job2"] = "note2"
    v.finish(rid2, [])
    # notes should be preserved
    assert v.notes == {"job1": "note1", "job2": "note2"}

def test_loading_exposed():
    v = View()
    assert v.loading == False
    rid = v.begin("query1")
    assert v.loading == True
    v.finish(rid, [])
    assert v.loading == False

    test_begin_clears_error()
